description: Explicit country registry. All 12 filename-to-country associations are user_confirmed following the user's clarification of individual Giovanni country selections and manual filename labels. Original shapes, checksums and geographic limitations are preserved.
source_report: User confirms downloading each of the 12 countries individually from NASA Giovanni and manually renaming the datasets with the corresponding country suffixes.
geographic_limitation: Country associations remain user_confirmed; all 12 reproduction URL shape references match the previous registry exactly. Exports do not independently name countries or include polygon coordinates. Previous metadata is archived under metadata/history/phase_5d/.

countries.evidence: User explicitly confirms personally selecting Argentina individually in NASA Giovanni and manually assigning the _ARG.csv filename suffix to that country. This is user-confirmed selection provenance, not independent geographic verification.

provenance_history.evidence: Candidate only: filename suffix _ARG; user reports one download per country, but has not confirmed this filename label or shape-to-country mapping.

coverage.coverage_note: Phase 5F read-only audit: export requests through October 2026, but contains monthly observations only through September 2026. October is absent from all 12 exports; no observation is inferred or fabricated.
